Both exits leave arithmetic in v0 (addiu v0,a1,-1 at 0x3defdc and addiu v0,v0,-1 at 0x3defec; the loop ends at -1, bne v0,v1 at 0x3deffc). RECONSTRUCTION.md Return width and PLANNER.md allow void only when no exit sets v0, or the only leftover is a lui v0 used as a load/store base; a copy, arithmetic or a callee result keeps the return unresolved. The plan's own note calls the value the loop down-counter, which is exactly an arithmetic leftover, and the strings.h declaration is not in the workspace and the doc has no declaration exception for void. Fix: mark 0x3defd8 unresolved with the reason 'return unproven: exit leaves the loop down-counter in v0 (addiu v0,a1,-1 / addiu v0,v0,-1)', recording the proven contract (a0 untyped byte-cleared pointer, a1 uint byte count, size_t 4 bytes), then re-validate, regenerate the program, rerun preflight-batch and hand off again. The live prototype void bzero(void *, size_t) stays untouched meanwhile. Everything else (srand void via lui v0 base, abs/memchr/memcmp/memcpy/memmove/memset/_hi0bits/_lo0bits/__mcmp/_ulp/__errno, the stage 2 restatements, the receiver for LoadLibs) is fine.

(2) 0x1b47b0 CZAnimBlendMode::GetBlendMode returns int from constants only (li 0/1/2 at 0x1b47f4,0x1b4828,0x1b485c-0x1b4908). review_history.reason: Two findings, same cause. 0x2083d0 CZPersonaState::FindNextTerrIndexEx and 0x2085f0 CZPersonaState::FindNextSealIndexEx are typed int, but their only callers narrow the result with andi s1,v0,0xff (0x20439c, 0x2043ac in zRemoteClientConnectsCallback), which is the established positive evidence for uchar, while the body returns the un-narrowed 32-bit counter and li v0,-1 (sign-extended), which argues against uchar: the evidence is mixed. The cited precedent does not match: the accepted sibling FindNextTerrIndex (0x2084a0) has callers that do not narrow (sb v0,720(s0) at 0x20819c and 0x209428, a byte store; FindNextSealIndex passes it as the int a2 at 0x20821c) and GetItemIndex has callers comparing the full register with -1; the Ex callers do neither. No declaration or DWARF exists. Fix: make both rows unresolved with the reason 'return width mixed: callers narrow with andi 0xff (uchar evidence) but the body returns sign-extended -1 and an un-narrowed counter (int evidence); no declaration', keeping the proven parts (static, no parameters, a0 not read). Everything else in the plan checked out: validate, program identity, preflight skips, draft --check, the void rows 0x1f3fb0 (chain closes at RemoteGameUpdateCallback PFiii_v and RemoteGameCreationCallback PFii_v, a3/a2 of zNetRegisterRemoteObjectCallback at 0x206964/0x206960) and 0x2041c0 (a1 of zNetJoin, first PFii_v, at 0x201860/0x203cf4), so a resubmission needs only these two rows changed. Note for the planner: the 0x1f3fb0 evidence omits that RemoteGameUpdateCallback is also called directly from RemoteGameCreationCallback (0x2062f0, returns it), which is itself address-taken as PFii_v; the conclusion stands.
